title: KATSEYE Is Coming to NYC for a ‘WILD’ Private Party & Performance
summary: The group's top Spotify listeners are getting an invite to Klub KATSEYE.
contentText:
Things are about to get wild for KATSEYE ‘s top Spotify listeners. Spotify will be hosting Klub KATSEYE, an exclusive fan event in New York City on Aug. 11, celebrating the release of the global girl group’s upcoming EP, WILD . The event will be invite-only for top EYEKONS on the music platform, offering the group’s biggest fans the chance to experience WILD before its release.

Designed around the EP itself, the event will have immersive, album-inspired installations, as well as a performance from KATSEYE.

Fans who aren’t able to attend won’t have to miss out entirely. Exclusive video content from the evening will be available on Spotify later in August, giving listeners around the globe a behind-the-scenes peek at the party and KATSEYE’s performance.

The event arrives as KATSEYE continues to ascend on the charts. The group’s most recent EP, Beautiful Chaos , debuted at No. 4 on the Billboard 200 , marking its first entry into the top 10 on the chart. The lead single from the anticipated WILD EP, “Pinky Up,” has so far peaked at No. 28 on the Billboard Hot 100 .

Plus, new single “Animal,” which arrived July 24, debuts at No. 10 on the Global 200 on the chart dated Aug. 8. The track, cowritten with superstar Ed Sheeran, is the group’s first top 10 on the tally, and according to Luminate, earned 29.8 million streams and 3,000 sold worldwide in week one.

The five-track project WILD (six, if EYEKONS purchase the Target exclusive that features a track written and produced by Lara Raj) arrives Aug. 14.
